title: Context Extractor
description: Pulls the goals, rules, decisions, open questions, and key facts out of a long chat into a short summary.

title: Portable Context Engine
description: Reusable instruction profiles with fill-in variables, copied as one block into any AI chat.

title: Multi-Model Workspace
description: Ask an OpenAI and an Anthropic model the same question side by side with your own keys.

title: Context Window Optimizer
description: Shows how much of a model's context window a prompt fills, with tips if it is too long.

title: Agent Stateboard
description: Simulation of a planner, worker, and checker passing work along a fixed path, including a failed check.

title: NanoBanana Compiler
description: Turns a few architecture choices into an image-model prompt and JSON spec for a diagram.

title: Prompt Matrix Evaluator
description: Removes common filler from a prompt and shows the estimated token change.

title: Token Router
description: Simulation of a shared token budget serving urgent requests first and holding background jobs.

title: Claude Context Engine
description: Rewrites messy context into a tighter prompt using a hosted model. Sends text to a server.

title: Prompt Diff & Stager
description: Word-by-word prompt comparison with fill-in variables, snapshots, and token estimates.
